title: Chore Completion Leaderboard
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`).
app: Baby-tracking apps (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook exports), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, and growth logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chore:completion
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(eval(if(status="done",1,0))) as done, count as assigned by person _time
| eval rate=round(100*done/assigned)
| stats avg(rate) as completion by person
| sort - completion
description: Ranks who in the household actually finished their chores each week, a friendly (or fierce) family leaderboard.
value: A visible chore scoreboard motivates kids far better than nagging and settles the eternal who-does-more debate with data.
implementation: Log chore completions to `index=personal`; schedule weekly and rank family members by completion rate.
visualization: Bar chart of chore completion rate by person.
grandmaExplanation: It shows who in the family actually did their chores each week, which is a fun and motivating scoreboard.
